name: Gen. Antonio Luna
lore: Brilliant and fiery general of the Philippine Revolutionary Army. A pharmacist turned military strategist, Luna modernized Filipino warfare and was known for his iron discipline and tactical genius.

abilities.name: Iron Discipline
abilities.description: Nearby allied units gain +15% attack speed within 150 tiles.

abilities.name: Tactical Barrage
abilities.description: Orders a concentrated artillery strike on target area. Deals 120 damage to all units in 80-tile radius after 2s delay.

abilities.name: General's Command
abilities.description: All allied units within 300 tiles gain +25% damage and +20% move speed for 20 seconds.
